walkthroughs.body_html: Biodiversity exists at three levels. Genetic diversity is variation within a species, supporting adaptation. Species diversity is the number and abundance of species in an area. Ecosystem diversity covers the range of habitats from coral reefs to peat bogs. High biodiversity generally means greater resilience to disturbance.

Indicator species reveal environmental quality. Lichens are sensitive to SO2 so their abundance shows clean air. Freshwater invertebrates like mayfly nymphs and stoneflies indicate clean water, while bloodworms and rat-tailed maggots tolerate pollution. Tracking indicator species over time gives early warning of ecosystem change.

Sea otters eat sea urchins. Without otters, urchin populations explode and graze kelp forests into barrens. Removing the keystone species cascades through the whole ecosystem. Other examples include wolves in Yellowstone reshaping rivers via trophic cascades, and beavers creating wetlands that support countless species.

options: Has disproportionate ecosystem impact
Is always the most abundant
Only lives in deserts
Is always endangered

mcqs.q: Why is a cold winter not evidence against climate change?
options: It is evidence - if it gets cold sometimes, warming must be wrong.
Because polar bears help spread heat.
Cold winters are caused by warming.
Climate refers to long-term averages, not individual weather events.

mcqs.q: Why is ice-albedo feedback a positive feedback loop?
options: Less ice means less reflective surface, so more sunlight is absorbed, causing more warming and more melting.
Because polar bears help spread heat.
Because warming is positive (a good thing).
Forest fires alone.

mcqs.q: What is the leading driver of global deforestation?
options: Forest fires alone.
Agriculture (especially cattle ranching, soy, palm oil).
Logging for timber and paper.
Because polar bears help spread heat.
